rows.preview: In 2026, Artemis crews will use neutron spectrometers to map water ice at the lunar poles.
These advanced instruments help scientists detect hydrogen, indicating water ice beneath the surface
Mapping these resources is crucial for future lunar missions and potential colonization.
Neutron spectrometers operate by emitting neutrons and analyzing the resulting interactions.
This technology could redefine our understanding of lunar geology and resource availability.
As we prepare for Artemis, the quest for lunar water ice is just beginning.
